untrusted_API_characterization.scope: nonblocking limitation for canonical experimental fixture only; not production admission

limits: PASS is strictly a synthetic attention/position-hook CPU witness, not checkpoint, vision, model-quality, production/security or loader admission.
Synthetic unquantized hidden32 projections and norm weights, F32/F16, B=1, 24 query heads/4 KV heads/head dimension256. Not the 5120-wide 27B checkpoint; no checkpoint loaded.

Original LM and VLM attention class ASTs and native KVCache execute unchanged. Synthetic projection and norm module objects are shared by identity. The candidate instance replaces only its rope attribute; invocation globals deliberately select the common original LM ordinary-KV SDPA helper for both.

Only the terminal ordinary native SDPA call AST matches. Full VLM base helper is different and unexecuted TurboQuant/quantized-KV/sinks/padding/left-padded paths are not admitted. Some unexercised VLM branches have deliberately absent fixture globals.
The comparison shares the native rotary implementation and common SDPA helper. It tests interface/position/cache seam consistency, not an independent mathematical or trained-checkpoint oracle.

Forward-step groups mean 42 paired reference/candidate intervals, each with output/live-key/live-value metrics. They do not mean 126 forward steps or all16 attention layers. Both full native runs together include extra scalar and mutation forwards.
The two decode steps use deterministic random synthetic hidden states; these are physical cache increments, not model-generated autoregressive token/logit evidence.

No BF16, Metal kernel execution, vision encoder, actual image pixels, GDN state, MTP, full-model logits, quantized projections/KV, two-host transport, cache-all16 integration, screenshot actions, or performance qualification.
The callback redundantly rotates x as both Q and K on each original single-input rope invocation; no speedup or memory-scaling claim follows.

Historical two-cycle TDD chronology is preserved as the parent artifact tool-declared trace; no contemporaneous raw RED/GREEN stdout exists in the supplied witness directory, and session search returned no archived trace. Only the current two protocol tests were independently executed. No TDD claim extends beyond those two.

The original preflight failure and successful result/result-with-mutations remain byte-for-byte preserved. The separate NumPy-to-native five F32 numerical failures remain failures and are not cleared by this witness.

The workspace root is not a git repository. Source nonmodification claims use before/after scoped hashes; the three VLM source files are additionally clean at the pinned local upstream commit. No global workspace cleanliness claim is made, and concurrent other-child new bridge work is excluded.
